verdict.rationale: Slate is a terminal-based coding agent. Inline completions are a fair question for a coding assistant, so the axis applies. The pack documents only chat-driven agent sessions, orchestration and skills, with no inline code completions or next-edit suggestions. Tab queues messages rather than accepting completions, so it is an unrelated control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive inline code completions and next-edit suggestions as I type
